title: Hot Wheels Let's Race
summary: Hot Wheels Let's Race is an American 3D CGI animated television series developed by Rob David, Melanie Shannon, and Jordan Gershowitz (based on Mattel's Hot Wheels). The series debuted on Netflix on 4 March 2024. The second batch of episodes debuted on 9 September 2024.
